purpose: Move the single active Layer-B v2 slot to one response-unopened Illinois coyote system after the India tiger attempt closed at a terminal pre-response transport STOP.

dataset.title: Camera trap detections and environmental covariates for modeling scale-dependent coyote (Canis latrans) site-use intensity across Illinois, USA (2021–2024)

dryad_record.role: source identity, file separation and README response semantics
facts: dataset states 175 statewide camera-trap locations sampled during 2021-2024
Coyote_Detection_History.csv is listed separately from deployment, effort and site-covariate files
spatial unit is camera trap site and temporal unit is weekly repeated sampling occasion
README describes o1-o28 as coyote detections by camera-specific survey week and N/A as inactive occasion
README states the files are linked by a common site identifier

journal_of_biogeography_2026.role: independent target inclusion and empirical support
facts: analysis retained 164 cameras over 24 survey weeks after quality filtering
coyotes were detected at 162 camera sites (naive occupancy 0.99)
46 cameras were deployed in 2021/22 and 54 cameras in 2022/23
the study explicitly treated study year as a temporal factor

proposed_target_before_response.positive_rule: documented o1-o28 count > 0 for an active camera-week
proposed_target_before_response.negative_rule: documented o1-o28 count == 0 for an active camera-week
proposed_target_before_response.inactive_rule: README-documented N/A/inactive occasions are excluded, never converted to negatives
proposed_target_before_response.effort_role: Effort_DetVariable.csv determines response-independent weekly camera activity/effort and is not a biological response table

prospective_nested_partition.reason: three chronologically ordered, independently documented survey years provide a natural nested temporal validation sequence

automatic_stop_conditions: Dryad live metadata or allowed nonresponse-file transport cannot be qualified reproducibly
exact response header/algebra/join/missing semantics cannot be frozen independently of Coyote_Detection_History.csv payload
fewer than 50 unique public station-level coordinates are reproduced
independent pre-response evidence cannot establish enough positive and negative active site-weeks in each inner-train, inner-validation and untouched-outer year for frozen estimability minima
study-year labels or deployment structure contradict the prospective three-year split
